changelog.name: V.2.7
changelog.body: [跳至中文版 / Jump to Chinese Version](#zh-hant) # 🚀 Update / New Features – Release Notes > [!WARNING] > ⚠️ **Breaking Update:** This version uses a new signing key. You must **uninstall the old version first** before installing this update. > [!IMPORTANT] > 📦 **Open Source → Closed Source:** This update marks a transition from open source to closed source. No source code will be provided starting from this version. ## ✨ What’s New - 🕶️ **Sensitive Info Hider — Rebuilt** — You can now turn it off or customize it further to hide custom text. - 🎨 **Software Card — Improved** — Rebuilt animation with One UI style, added support for custom images, fonts, and text, and added tap-to-replay animation. - 📱 **One UI 7 to 8.5 — New Specific Features** — Added One UI 9-style drawable image replacement and a One UI 9-style Settings home page (off by default). - 📊 **Dashboard Icon — Improvements / New Additions** — Added Material Design Filled Rounded icons and variants with Pixel-style backgrounds, and updated PUI Theme icons with the latest source. - 🔤 **Font Check Bypass & Extra Battery Info — Now Toggleable** — You can now turn off the font validity check bypass and the extra battery information display. - 🧪 **Laboratory** — You can now display non-Samsung Bluetooth devices on your home page, just like Galaxy Buds (Beta). ## 🐛 Bug Fixes and Improvements - 🛠️ Completely rebuilt the app with Material Design Expressive. - 🌐 Fixed some translation issues. ## 📄 License & Privacy — Important > **This version includes major updates to the License (EULA) and Privacy Policy. Please read them carefully before using or forwarding this content.** - 📜 [License (EULA)](LICENSE) - 🔐 [Privacy Policy](Privacy_Policy.txt) > [!NOTE] > You must agree to and comply with these terms when using or forwarding this content. --- ## Traditional Chinese [⬆️ 返回頂部 / Back to Top](#top) # 🚀 更新 / 新功能 – 發行說明 > [!WARNING] > ⚠️ **破壞性更新：** 此版本更換了簽名，安裝前必須**先解除安裝舊版本**。 > [!IMPORTANT] > 📦 **開源轉為閉源：** 本次更新起，專案將從開源轉為閉源，不再提供原始碼。 ## ✨ 更新內容 - 🕶️ **敏感資訊隱藏器 — 重建** — 現在可以關閉，或透過自訂文字進一步自訂要隱藏的內容。 - 🎨 **軟體卡片 — 改良** — 以 One UI 風格重建動畫，支援自訂圖片、字型與文字，並新增點擊重播動畫。 - 📱 **One UI 7 至 8.5 — 新增特定功能** — 新增 One UI 9 風格 drawable 圖片替換，以及 One UI 9 風格設定首頁（預設關閉）。 - 📊 **儀表板圖示 — 改良 / 新增** — 新增 Material Design Filled Rounded 圖示，以及搭配 Pixel 風格背景的變體，並使用最新來源更新 PUI Theme 圖示。 - 🔤 **越過字型檢查與更多電池資訊 — 現在可關閉** — 現在可以關閉越過字型檢查及顯示更多電池資訊。 - 🧪 **實驗室** — 現在可以在首頁顯示非 Samsung 藍牙裝置，就像 Galaxy Buds 一樣（Beta）。 ## 🐛 錯誤修正與改良 - 🛠️ 以 Material Design Expressive 完全重建應用程式。 - 🌐 修正部分翻譯問題。 ## 📄 授權與隱私 — 重要 > **此版本大幅更新了授權條款（EULA）與隱私政策。使用或轉發本內容前，請務必仔細閱讀。** - 📜 [授權條款（EULA）](LICENSE) - 🔐 [隱私政策](Privacy_Policy.txt) > [!NOTE] > 使用或轉發本內容時，您必須同意並遵守上述條款。
